title: Moon Shadow Speed Mystery

scenes.text: When the Moon blocks the Sun, its shadow races at over 1,600 km/h.
The eclipse shadow travels faster than most passenger jets, reaching around 1,600 km per hour.
scenes.label: SHADOW SPEED EXCEEDS JET

scenes.text: At the point of totality, the Moon's umbra can be as narrow as about 100 kilometers, roughly the size of a large city.
scenes.label: UMBRA NARROW AS CITY

scenes.text: Because Earth's rotation adds to the Moon's motion, the shadow moves quickest near the equator, sometimes over 2,000 km/h.
scenes.label: FASTEST AT EQUATOR

scenes.text: Follow for a mind-blowing fact every day.

description: Discover how the Moon's eclipse shadow outruns jets, narrows to city size, and speeds up at the equator. Stay curious and hit follow!
